title: Glowing bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bowGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bowGrad2" x1="100%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="42" ry="30" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Left bow -->
  <path d="M 48 48 L 18 32 Q 12 28 14 38 L 18 46 Q 20 52 26 52 L 44 50 Z" fill="url(#bowGrad)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M 48 52 L 18 68 Q 12 72 14 62 L 18 54 Q 20 48 26 48 L 44 50 Z" fill="url(#bowGrad2)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Right bow -->
  <path d="M 52 48 L 82 32 Q 88 28 86 38 L 82 46 Q 80 52 74 52 L 56 50 Z" fill="url(#bowGrad2)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M 52 52 L 82 68 Q 88 72 86 62 L 82 54 Q 80 48 74 48 L 56 50 Z" fill="url(#bowGrad)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Center knot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="7" ry="8" fill="#FFE44D" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#FFF8DC" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Highlight sparkles -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
